summary: Tyler Technologies disclosed entry into a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan to repurchase up to $150 million of its common stock from June 16 to July 30, 2026, as part of a $1.0 billion board-authorized repurchase program (February 3, 2026) with $332.7 million remaining. The plan is prearranged and complies with Rule 10b5-1 to allow repurchases even if material non-public information arises. Funding comes from cash and credit facility; no premium, tender, or structural changes. Watch for execution pace and impact on shares outstanding; no risk-arb angle as this is an open-market buyback.
